Maya (CS): Customer hit a 422 from the rerank endpoint and all returned scores are 0. They shipped a payload with both "doc_chunks" inside documents and a separate "candidates" array. Posting the minimal payload they used below.

Maya (CS): ```json
{
  "query": "best restaurants near me",
  "documents": [
    {
      "id": "d1",
      "text": "Italian place",
      "doc_chunks": [ { "text": "pasta" } ],
      "query": "should-not-be-here"  
    }
  ],
  "candidates": [
    {
      "id": "c1",
      "text": "Italian place - pasta menu"
    }
  ]
}
```

Devon (PM): hmm, nested "query" inside documents[0] — that will shadow top-level query in our validator. Was the customer building this payload client-side?

Maya (CS): They said they used our python client but wrapped a previous search result into "documents" and accidentally left the per-doc "query" field from the search response.

Ravi (Eng): Can you paste the exact response body? Might be our schema error message.

Maya (CS): Response was: ```json
{
  "error": "422 Unprocessable Entity",
  "message": "ambiguous query: nested ‘query’ found in documents[0]; top-level ‘query’ required for rerank. Remove nested field or rename to ‘metadata.query’.",
  "code": "AmbiguousQueryField"
}
```

Devon (PM): Customer says they only started seeing zero scores when they added "doc_chunks" too. Is there a rule forbidding both "doc_chunks" and "candidates"?

Ravi (Eng): Not forbidden overall, but we do canonicalize input: if documents contain nested snippets (doc_chunks/passages) we prefer those for scoring. The bug might be conflation when both doc-level "query" exists and top-level query also exists — validator rejects but client didn't surfacing structured error properly, leading client library to treat as empty results (score 0).

Maya (CS): Repro steps I gave the customer: 1) PUT payload above via curl 2) observe 422 and returned error 3) remove nested "query" from documents -> rerank returns expected non-zero scores. They confirmed that fixes it.

Maya (CS): Escalating to eng for two things: a) clearer validation error text in API (so client libs don't swallow it), b) consider allowing namespaced "metadata.query" in doc objects instead of rejecting when top-level exists.

Ravi (Eng): Thanks — I can reproduce locally. I'll add a unit test for nested "query" detection and ensure the client lib surfaces the 422 body. Will also add a short note to docs about "documents" vs "candidates" and how per-doc fields are treated.

ci-bot: Issue created: CS-1178 - "rerank: ambiguous nested query in documents causes 422/zero-scores". Link: https://tracker/redwood/CS-1178

Devon (PM): tagging customer and keeping them updated. Maya, please include customer id and time in the ticket. :thumbsup:

Maya (CS): done, added customer id and example curl to the ticket. Closing loop with them now.
